findings.title: open_root_help referenced as both a concrete name and 'equivalent'
findings.where: context-help design.md '--help dispatch hook' pseudocode; tasks.md task 25.4
findings.problem: The enforced-root-aware help open is named open_root_help in the design pseudocode but task 25.4 says 'open_root_help/equivalent'. It is an illustrative name, not a committed public seam, so the slight inconsistency is cosmetic and does not affect the behaviour-level criteria (Req 22.1/22.8).
findings.fix: Optional: add one sentence stating open_root_help is an illustrative name for the enforced-root branch; the implementer may inline it into open_help provided there is ONE resolution path for a root's help.

findings.title: Req 21.4 ties the 200-char cap to Status_Message length without citing the requirement id
findings.problem: 21.4 says '<= 200 characters (consistent with command-semantics Status_Message length)' but does not cite the specific command-semantics requirement id. command-semantics does define Status_Message as short (<=200 characters), so the value is unambiguous; only the traceability cross-ref id is missing.
findings.fix: Optional: cite the command-semantics Status_Message definition id for traceability.
